_comment: Publish quality gate configuration. Every automated post must pass ALL gates before shipping.

gates.name: Duplicate Topic Check
gates.description: Reject if the target query already has a ranking page. Update the existing page instead.

gates.name: Source URL Verification
gates.description: HEAD-request every cited source URL. Reject if any return 404/5xx or if the source name doesn't match the domain.
checks: Source name matches domain (e.g., 'Bloomberg' must link to bloomberg.com, not yahoo.com)
URL is not a paywall-only page with no preview content

gates.name: Template Phrase Detection
gates.description: Scan for known AI template fingerprints. Reject if any are found.
patterns: the longer answer is more interesting

gates.name: Shared Closer Detection
gates.description: Compare the closing section against recent posts. Reject if >40% of recent posts share the same closing structure.

gates.name: Minimum Word Count
gates.description: Enforce format-specific word count minimums from format-rotation.json.

gates.name: TypeScript Compilation
gates.description: Run tsc on the post file. If it doesn't compile, it doesn't ship.

gates.name: Internal Link Check
gates.description: Warn if the post doesn't link to any existing content. Posts should be nodes in a graph, not orphans.

gates.name: Schema Markup Present
gates.description: Warn if the post is missing Article schema, FAQ schema, or author entity.

gates.name: Fact Consistency
gates.description: Check that key numbers (valuations, funding amounts, dates) don't contradict existing published content.
gates.note: Contradicted facts across posts tank E-E-A-T. If your site says $800B and $2.6T for the same company, Google trusts neither.
